hooks.command: PYTHON_BIN=python3; command -v "$PYTHON_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || PYTHON_BIN=python; "$PYTHON_BIN" -c 'import pathlib,runpy,sys;p=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve();s=next((r/".codex/hooks/codex_hook.py" for r in (p,*p.parents) if (r/".codex/hooks/codex_hook.py").is_file()),None);assert s,"Codex hook script not found";sys.argv=[str(s),"session-start"];runpy.run_path(str(s),run_name="__main__")'
